description: Defines the ParsedCertificate class and related structures for handling X.509 certificates, including creation, accessors for certificate fields, and extension handling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: ParsedCertificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate with methods to access its fields and extensions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a ParsedCertificate from DER-encoded data, returning nullptr on failure.

methods.name: CreateAndAddToVector
methods.description: Creates a ParsedCertificate and adds it to a chain vector if successful.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specific extension by OID from the certificate.
